name: Tuesday Night Dads
description: Dads of little ones walking through the Gospel of Mark. We keep it simple: read, pray, and actually check in on each other.

name: Sunday Lunch D-Group
description: We meet right after second service over lunch at the Carters' house. Men's discipleship group, Romans this fall.

name: Women of the Word
description: Moms in the middle years reading through Philippians. Kids are welcome in the next room on the first Thursday.

name: First Steps
description: A slow walk through the Gospel of John for people who are new to faith or coming back to it. Questions are welcome.

name: Young Couples
description: Married couples without kids yet, or with one on the way. Monday dinners and a marriage study.

name: Second Half
description: Empty nesters and recent retirees. Saturday breakfast, Psalms, and a serving project each quarter.

name: Saturday Men's Breakfast
description: Men of every season. Breakfast, a chapter of Proverbs, and accountability.

name: Parents of Teens
description: Honest conversation for parents navigating the teenage years, using a book study.

name: Thursday Twenties
description: Singles in their twenties and early thirties. Dinner, a book of the Bible, and real friendship.

name: Lakeside Women
description: Women's D-Group meeting near the lakes in Clermont. Reading plan plus prayer.

name: New Men's D-Group (forming)
description: A new men's discipleship group launching this winter for dads of young kids. Bible-reading plan and weekly check-ins.

name: New Women's D-Group (forming)
description: A new women's discipleship group. Reading through 1 John together.

name: Deep Roots
description: Women working chapter by chapter through a systematic theology text. Weekly reading and discussion questions; best for those who have studied the Bible for years.

name: Thursday Women in the Word
description: Young professional women reading one book of the Bible each month at a brisk pace, with memory-verse goals.

name: Midweek Prayer & Worship
description: An hour of worship and prayer for our church and city. Little discussion, lots of prayer.

name: Tuesday Men's Accountability
description: Men who want hard questions and real accountability. A short passage, then most of the night on confession and prayer.

name: Men of Iron
description: Older men going line by line through Romans with commentaries. Seasoned, theological, and unhurried.

name: Sunday Supper Families
description: Young families share supper on Sunday evenings. Kids play while parents talk through the sermon.

name: Clermont Moms Morning
description: Moms of little ones on Tuesday mornings in Clermont. Kids welcome; we take turns watching them.

name: Online Thursday Study
description: An online video study for people who travel, work shifts, or mostly join services by livestream. Cameras optional.
